'''Gilded Descent Casino''' was a casino in the [[Red Light Sector (Corellia)|Red Light Sector]] of the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The casino doubled as a base of operations for newly arrived [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] soldiers during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
